dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Ahem! The Goth Grand Hotel has been reserved for the Fatui delegation alone.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: No access for unauthorized persons!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long have you been standing there...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: You trying to get me to abandon my post? Surely you don't think I'm falling for that!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Loyal Luke never abandons his post! I must keep watch over the— Ahem! Diplomatic mission!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Ahem... Almost let it slip there... Anyway, no loitering for unauthorized persons, so get outta here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are the Fatui in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: *tut* The Fatui do not simply show up in a place for no reason!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: It's because those Knights of Favonius can't handle the Stormterror issue properly.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: When Mondstadt is on the back foot, we Fatui will make our move... Then, whether it's pretext for stationing troops or gaining diplomatic sway...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: ...Bah, I've said too much! You did this on purpose...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: You heard nothing, and if you did it wasn't from me, you understand?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can the Fatui solve the problem with Stormterror?

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Hah! You dare question the abilities of the Fatui!?

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: I've had the honor of seeing the youngest among the Harbingers, Childe, in action once. It was quite a scene, even I...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Well now look what you've made me say! Ahem, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: If the Fatui's Harbingers were to get involved, Stormterror wouldn't even stand a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: *grunting*

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Scram! Stop pestering me!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Just like his excellency said...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you going to find shelter?

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'm enjoying the view! This is a golden opportunity for the Fatui to...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: ...To ask you to mind your own business!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: This wind is nothing compared to back home in Snezhnaya, so stop making a mountain out of a molehill. Go away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Oh, well to be perfectly honest with you, this is my first trip on business here. The Stormterror issue is much more serious than I had imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: But I remain fully confident that once Signora arrives in Mondstadt, even ten such dragons would prove to be no challenge for her. With just the flick of her finger she could...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Ah, uh, never mind... You didn't hear anything from me!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: ...In any case, I'm sure it won't be too long before these Mondstadters come crying to the Fatui, begging for us to step in.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Even if they keep talking tough, it'll be their own people who suffer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Hmph. It seems that these Knights of Favonius aren't all talk after all. To think that they were able to solve the dragon crisis without the help of the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: But I suppose fortune was also on their side. I've heard that it was only by the intervention of a mysterious traveler that the crisis was finally resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: I've never seen that traveler before. I wonder what that fellow looks like.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: But it matters not. Our diplomats have already reported this to the higher-ups. A single traveler couldn't...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: ...Hah! If you thought I'd say more than that, you're sorely mistaken!
